page: Microsoft Azure E192ds_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the Edsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 192 vCPUs and 96 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It includes 11339 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, with no bundled GPUs.

Performance benchmarks place this server in the top tier for multi-core processing and memory bandwidth. The stress-ng multi-core test reached 202544.14, and the PassMark CPU score registered at 152200.24. Memory read-only bandwidth for large blocks reached 687.65 GB/sec, while write bandwidth was recorded at 270.43 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET performance are also top-tier, with Redis achieving 252.84 million operations per second. The CPU features advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX for accelerated matrix mathematics.

While single-core performance is average, the massive parallel processing capability and high memory density offer strong qualitative cost efficiency for large-scale enterprise workloads. The absence of a dedicated GPU limits its suitability for heavy real-time graphics rendering, but the built-in Intel AMX instructions allow it to handle large LLM prompt processing efficiently, achieving 42.66 tokens/sec on a 70B model. This server is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale Redis caching layers, high-throughput web serving, and complex multi-threaded data processing.
